title.narrative: Empowering marginalized teen girls in Morocco. Girls Soar with the Norwegian Embassy (GSN)

description.narrative:
In a 2019 survey, the Moroccan High Commission for Planning found that 57% of women across all age groups had been subjected to violence. Girls and young women ages 15-19 had a yet higher prevalence rate, with 71% having been subjected to violence. The project will have an overarching goal of fostering gender equity by empowering marginalized teen girls in Morocco. Target groups include: 1) teen girls - the majority are 13-18 and living in poverty in underserved areas with parents who have limited education; and 2) community members - living in an underserved community where project activities take place.
The Project’s expected effect(s) on society (Impact): Greater gender equity in 12 marginalized communities in Morocco as target girls stay in school and avoid child marriage.
The expected effects for the target group of the Project (Outcome): 1. Teen girls better equipped to advocate for their rights, including gender equality. 2. Teen girls better equipped to manage their physical wellbeing. 3. Increased community awareness of issues essential to teen girl rights and wellness.
